current_claim: Held-key cliff is a current-metric fact; held key and complete keypress are separate metrics.
overturning_observation: An exact-spec rerun after a helper, browser, trace, throwaway, or statistic change removes the cliff or collapses the mode split.
immediate_consequence: Reopen the metric definition and threshold-continuity discussion before citing old rows.
existing_signal: Current dense, fresh, randomized, and helper-control rows agree.
minimum_next_check: Triggered exact-spec rerun only after the metric definition changes.

current_claim: Persistence timing is an ordering marker, not proof that callback work moved out of the next key.
overturning_observation: A joined task/runtime trace shows callback work, next-key work, and counterfactual placement in the same retained-key window.
immediate_consequence: Upgrade wording from ordering marker to a named work-placement mechanism.
existing_signal: Timer rewrites and marker/no-op controls align with ordering but reject simple store-work wording.
minimum_next_check: Joined task/runtime work-placement trace only if mechanism wording is needed.

current_claim: The cliff is held-key benchmark behavior, not product-wide typing behavior.
overturning_observation: Representative replay strata reproduce the same cliff and owner pattern under tap, pauses, deletion, selection, and realistic text.
immediate_consequence: Widen the claim to the passing replay strata; keep fixed-`x` as one stratum.
existing_signal: Tap and complete-keypress rows do not reproduce the held-key cliff.
minimum_next_check: Synthetic and recorded replay strata with per-key rows and source spans.

current_claim: Runtime checkpoint state is empirical and unnamed.
overturning_observation: A passive retained-key sidecar joins every key and names a runtime field that separates low and high bands without perturbing ordering.
immediate_consequence: Name the runtime mechanism; otherwise keep empirical wording.
existing_signal: Runtime checkpoints produce a dose response, but current rows are not passive mechanism evidence.
minimum_next_check: Passive sidecar with helper/renderer identity, clock sync, and observer-off baseline.

current_claim: CPU/QoS sensitivity is plausible, but the exact layer is unnamed.
overturning_observation: Joined counters separate retained-key classes by frequency, residency, scheduler latency, cache, QoS, or timer-wakeup state.
immediate_consequence: Name only the passing counter layer; otherwise downgrade to empirical system-state sensitivity.
existing_signal: Local CPU controls move latency, but counters are not joined per retained key.
minimum_next_check: Accepted sidecar followed by powermetrics, trace, or browser-counter windows.

current_claim: Retained q50 does not justify adding a Typing startup wait; first-key tails and readiness still gate wait reduction.
overturning_observation: Target Performance Tests topology shows shorter waits preserve q50 while failures, resources, retained counts, and first-key tails regress.
immediate_consequence: Block wait reduction or split idle-input from retained typing.
existing_signal: Local startup rows show flat retained q50 but visible first/second-key differences.
minimum_next_check: Target-topology artifact with failures, retries, resources, retained rows, and key position.

current_claim: Local shorter waits or predicates are candidates, not rollout proof.
overturning_observation: Predicate/fallback rows move preview/canvas or endpoint work before timing, or fail in CI/container/Site/Post lanes.
immediate_consequence: Keep the fixed wait for failing lanes; do not count their runtime savings.
existing_signal: Local rows show q50 candidates and tail/resource caveats.
minimum_next_check: Predicate plus resource-quiet validation with endpoint composition and per-spec veto gates.

current_claim: Broad subscriber fanout is a credible source-cost target, but patches need behavior and source-span gates.
overturning_observation: Behavior fixtures fail, or targeted source spans do not collapse before aggregate timing moves.
immediate_consequence: Reject or rescope the patch before citing p50.
existing_signal: Source-span fanout and a first guarded prototype identify actionable owners.
minimum_next_check: Behavior fixtures plus before/after source-span microscope for the targeted owner.

current_claim: Timing/private side-channel wins do not prove public data-layer compatibility.
overturning_observation: Public subscribers, persistence selectors, dynamic dependencies, cross-store behavior, or async ordering change under partitioning.
immediate_consequence: Keep public root-notification semantics or restrict the change to a private path.
existing_signal: Private/side-channel rows reduce fanout, but compatibility is not proven.
minimum_next_check: Public subscriber compatibility matrix before timing claims.

current_claim: Fixed-`x` evidence is benchmark/source evidence only.
overturning_observation: Replay strata show different owners, opposite effects, failures, or missing assertions.
immediate_consequence: Keep product-wide wording blocked and report only the fixed-`x` artifact.
minimum_next_check: Synthetic and recorded workload replay strata with assertions and source spans.

current_claim: Current visual claims are Chromium-internal propagation, not physical display latency.
overturning_observation: Calibrated OCR, present, or camera endpoints disagree with internal timing or perturb retained-key ordering.
immediate_consequence: Keep display wording at the deepest passing endpoint only.
existing_signal: Internal Paint/DrawFrame and pixel proxies are useful but not calibrated physical endpoints.
minimum_next_check: Calibrated endpoint ladder joined to retained keys.

current_claim: q50 artifacts are evidence production; pass/fail policy is external.
overturning_observation: Dashboard, threshold, noisy-metric handling, or reviewer decisions use a different statistic or rule than local q50.
immediate_consequence: Stop predicting pass/fail from local q50; document only evidence production.
existing_signal: Repository source shows q50 production and display/upload consumers, not full policy.
minimum_next_check: Archived CI artifact to dashboard/reviewer decision join.
